_comment: Provenance for the Expo skills vendored into .agents/skills/. These were copied from Expo's official repository rather than installed by the 'skills' CLI, because they live under plugins/expo/skills/<name>/ rather than at the path that CLI expects — so they are not in skills-lock.json. Refresh them with tools/refresh-expo-skills.sh, which re-copies whole directories from upstream.

deliberatelyExcluded.expo-project-structure: teaches a generic src/ layout; KISOK's root architecture is settled
deliberatelyExcluded.expo-design-system: KISOK owns kisok-design-system and its token contract
deliberatelyExcluded.expo-tailwind-setup: NativeWind here is already set up and verified

_vendoredAtNote: The upstream commit these copies were taken from. Provenance for auditing a diff, NOT a pin: tools/refresh-expo-skills.sh clones the default branch tip, so re-running it takes whatever is newest.
